strapiBlog.title: World’s Tallest Hotel - Ciel Tower Dubai to Open in 2025
strapiBlog.short_description: Dubai is no stranger to architectural marvels and world records, and in 2025, another iconic addition is set to grace the city's skyline.

data.text:
Dubai is no stranger to architectural marvels and world records, and in 2025, another iconic addition is set to grace the city's skyline. Ciel Tower, the soon-to-be tallest hotel in the world, is preparing to open its doors in Dubai Marina. With a height of approximately 365 meters and 82 floors, the tower is a statement of ambition, innovation, and luxury.

Here’s a closer look at what guests can expect from this sky-high hotel.

About Ciel Tower

Ciel Tower is developed by The First Group and will be managed in partnership with IHG Hotels & Resorts under its Vignette Collection. Designed by the internationally acclaimed architectural firm NORR, the tower is poised to redefine upscale hospitality.

Once completed, it will surpass the current record-holder, the Gevora Hotel, claiming its title as the tallest hotel in the world.

Every element of Ciel Tower has been crafted with longevity and sustainability in mind. From energy-efficient glass to prefabricated facade panels and integrated water recycling systems, the tower is aligned with Dubai’s vision for sustainable urban development.

The hotel’s crowning feature—the rooftop observation deck—will offer more than just views; it will provide a sense of elevation that resonates with Dubai’s spirit.

Architectural Brilliance and Unique Design

Ciel Tower in Dubai Marina is a visual masterpiece. Its distinctive silhouette, capped with a dramatic sky terrace and open-air observation deck, promises panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf, Palm Jumeirah, and Dubai's glittering skyline.

The building also features 12 sky gardens, a glazed vertical atrium, and a rooftop infinity pool—elevating both aesthetics and guest experiences.

Unparalleled Amenities and Experiences

The amenities at this landmark hotel cater to every lifestyle. Ciel Hotel Dubai will feature over 1,000 guestrooms and suites, eight restaurants and bars, a luxury spa, fully equipped gyms, and three swimming pools—including one of the highest infinity pools in the world.

Guests can also look forward to a 360-degree observation deck on the 82nd floor and curated retail boutiques.

data.text:
What to Expect When Ciel Opens in 2025

With its grand opening expected in late 2025, Ciel Tower Dubai will set new standards in luxury accommodation. Booking details have yet to be announced, but travelers and investors alike are already keeping a close eye on updates. When operational, the hotel will also offer tailored executive services, business lounges, and exclusive access to IHG’s One Rewards program.

Ciel Tower's Location

The location of Ciel Tower in Dubai Marina places it at the center of one of Dubai's most dynamic neighborhoods. The property will be within walking distance of Marina Walk, JBR Beach, Bluewaters Island, and the Dubai Marina Mall.

Its connectivity to Sheikh Zayed Road and proximity to Dubai Metro ensures convenience for both leisure and business travelers.

Construction Timeline 

Initially expected to complete by 2023, the construction timeline was extended, with final handover now projected for 2025 and public opening set for later this year.

Building the tallest hotel in the world comes with unique engineering challenges—from massive foundation work to precision wind tunnel testing—all of which were expertly managed by the main contractor, China Railway 18th Bureau Group.

Explore More Iconic Projects in Dubai

As Dubai continues to break global records, another project worth reading about is the Burj Azizi—set to become the world’s second-tallest tower. Discover how Dubai is shaping the future of real estate and architectural innovation in our guide to Burj Azizi.

Other projects worth mentioning are Jumeirah Marsa Al Arab, inspired by superyacht design. It will offer an opulent resort experience near the iconic Burj Al Arab.

Jumeirah Asora Bay on La Mer South is another exciting development Asora Bay on La Mer South will introduce a coastal retreat with villas and oceanfront views. 

These visionary projects, alongside the Trump Tower and The Pearl Resort, showcase Dubai’s relentless push to innovate and elevate its global status in hospitality and real estate.

faqs.question: When is Ciel Tower expected to open?

data.answer: The hotel is scheduled to open to guests in late 2025.
It is located in Dubai Marina, close to JBR Beach and Marina Walk.

faqs.question: How tall will the tower be?

data.answer: Ciel Tower will be approximately 365 meters tall, making it the tallest hotel in the world.

faqs.question: Who is developing and managing the hotel?

data.answer: It is developed by The First Group and will be managed under IHG’s Vignette Collection.

faqs.question: Are bookings open for Ciel Tower?

data.answer: Not yet. Booking information will be announced closer to the opening date.
